note: Map modes, map legends and focus filters (docs/specs/07_interface/05_text_sweep.md family mapmodes). The strait and canal names of the installed game name real places; ZIN's map/adjacency_rules.txt defines no strait yet, so they are exempt in families.json until the map step names its own. Filters of vanilla country trees are exempt too.

lit.MAPMODE_COMPLIANCE_DESCRIPTION: Shows how obedient the occupied lands are.
lit.MAPMODE_DEBUG_NAVAL_ACCESSIBILITY:
Hold §GALT§! for the reach cache of {submarine:p:lc}
Hold §GSHIFT§! for the reach cache of surface ships
lit.MAPMODE_FACTIONS_DESCRIPTION: Shows which realms have joined which {faction:p:lc}.
lit.MAPMODE_IDEOLOGY_DESCRIPTION: Colours the realms by their alignment.
lit.MAPMODE_INFRASTRUCTURE_DESCRIPTION: Shows the state of the roads in each state.
lit.MAPMODE_OPERATIVES_DESCRIPTION: Shows the agents, their missions, the schemes under way and the spread of the web of spies.
lit.MAPMODE_RAIDS_DESCRIPTION: Shows every raid that is planned or under way
lit.MAPMODE_STRATEGIC_AIR_DESCRIPTION:
Shows strategic areas and lets you see what your wings are doing in each. 
§GGreen regions§! are held by our mastery of the sky, §Rred regions§! by the enemy's. 
Eyries with your wings based in them are marked.
lit.MAPMODE_STRATEGIC_NAVY_DESCRIPTION:
Shows strategic areas and lets you see what your fleets are doing in each. 
Regions where you rule the sea are outlined in §Ggreen§!. 
Areas striped §Rred§! lie beyond the reach of the fleet now selected.
lit.PERMISSION_DESC:
- Armies can pass: $ARMY$
 - Fleets can pass: $NAVY$
 - Corsairs can pass: $SUBMARINES$
 - Trade can pass: $TRADE$
